name: Knowledge Base
description: Create and manage knowledge bases (uploaded documents, Google Drive folders, websites); ingests content into a Graphiti knowledge graph and exposes kb_search/kb_retrieve tools to agents over MCP.

port.title: Port
port.description: HTTP port for the config UI bridge + MCP endpoint — 0 lets the OS assign one automatically (recommended, see docs/dev/apps/services.md §3).

graphitiEndpoint.title: Graphiti MCP endpoint
graphitiEndpoint.description: URL of your Graphiti MCP server, deployed externally (e.g. in Dokploy). Used for every Graphiti call. Editable in the config page — takes effect immediately, no reinstall needed.

episodeVerifyTimeoutSeconds.title: Episode verification timeout (seconds)
episodeVerifyTimeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for a queued episode to verifiably land in Graphiti (post-queue polling of get_episodes) before marking the source failed. Default 300s (5 min) — raise this if large chunked documents or your LLM/embeddings backend routinely need longer. Automatically scaled up (to at most 2x) while multiple sources are indexing concurrently, since they contend for the same Graphiti/LLM backend. Editable in the config page — takes effect immediately, no reinstall needed.
